segments.segment_summary: A man kneels in a cornfield and explains how different pests, like cutworms and wireworms, damage young corn plants. He begins digging with a trowel to demonstrate how to find the pests in the soil.

key_moments.caption: A close-up shot of a field with young corn sprouts, showing one plant clipped off and lying on the soil.
A man in a plaid shirt and jeans kneels down in the cornfield to inspect the plants.
Using a small hand trowel, the man begins to dig into the soil where a plant appears to be missing.
